Anwendung links wählen. In der Mitte, we: Pick an app on the left. In the middle, which profile Fleech uses there automatically — on the right, which ones the profile hotkey switches between there. Without an assignment, the default profile applies, or whatever you picked by hand.
Was der Profil-Hotkey in dieser Anwendun: What the profile hotkey cycles through in this app — and offers to choose from when held. Everything checked = no restriction.
Ausnahmen nach Fenstertitel — derselbe P: Exceptions by window title — the same process often carries very different contexts (one editor with code, one with notes). An exception wins over the profile above. Double-click removes it.
Trägt {app} beim Profil „{name}“ ein — d: Adds {app} to the profile “{name}” — the same rule you would create by hand below. Nothing is assigned until you click.
Stop suggesting this app. This is permanent; it can only be undone in settings.json (profiles.vorschlag_ignores). You can still give it a profile by hand below at any time.
Führt die Zuordnung vor, statt sie zu be: Shows the assignment at work instead of just claiming it: the foreground app, the profile it resolves to along with the rule, and what that changes about the dictation. Otherwise a typo in a title rule never shows — the rule just silently never applies.
Trägt den Fenstertitel der zuletzt im Vo: Fills in the window title of the last other app that was in the foreground — Fleech itself doesn’t count. You can still edit the title afterwards; usually you only want its stable part.
Noch kein fremdes Fenster gesehen — wech: No other window seen yet — switch over to one once.
Nur diesen Teil des Titels als Bedingung: Use only this part of the title as the condition — it stays put when the rest changes.
In {app} hast du {n} Diktate gemacht ({a: You have made {n} dictations in {app} ({anteil} % of all). No profile assigned.
In {app} hast du {n} Diktate gemacht. Ke: You have made {n} dictations in {app}. No profile assigned.
Dort nimmst du {n} von {gesamt} Mal „{pr: There you pick “{profil}” by hand {n} out of {gesamt} times.
Profile sind ausgeschaltet — für jedes D: Profiles are turned off — every dictation uses what is set under Settings → AI & Text.
Wenn du jetzt diktierst: keine Anwendung: If you dictate now: no app detected.
Ein Profil bestimmt, was aus dem Diktat: A profile decides what becomes of the dictation. Which app gets which profile is set on the “Apps” page — here, “All” is the default.
Gilt fuer alle folgenden Diktate, bis du: Applies to all following dictations until you change it — even after a restart. “App default” means: whatever is set for the app on the “Apps” page applies.
Dasselbe, was der Profil-Hotkey und der: The same as the profile hotkey and the dot on the pill — just without a running recording. The default profile is deliberately not offered: picked by hand, it would switch off the app assignment; that’s what “App default” is for.
Schreibt Profile und Schnellwechsel in e: Writes profiles and quick switch into a JSON file. Deliberately only that — the microphone and all other settings stay out, so the file can be shared.
Liest so eine Datei wieder ein. Additiv:: Reads such a file back in. Additive: unknown profiles are added, ones with the same name only after asking — nothing is ever deleted.
Gleichnamige Profile ersetzen?: Replace profiles with the same name?

Yes = overwrite with the file.
No = leave them, only add the unknown ones.
Punkt in der Pille, Profil-Hotkey und Au: The dot on the pill, the profile hotkey and the picker only go through these profiles. If you keep many but switch between two day to day, hide the rest here. The default profile is never part of it — instead there is the “App default” stop at the end of the cycle, which also lets the app assignment apply.
Name anklicken und tippen — Enter benenn: Click the name and type — Enter renames the profile.
Was aus dem Diktat wird. „Diktat“ = bere: What becomes of the dictation. “Dictation” = cleaned-up text as spoken. “Email” and “AI prompt” rewrite it: greeting and paragraphs, or concise bullet points for an AI.
Der fertige Text wird nach der Bereinigu: After cleanup, the finished text is translated into this language — you keep dictating in your own language. Needs an AI model; if the translation fails, the text arrives untranslated and the history says why.
Der Punkt vor dem Namen — und der Ring a: The dot before the name — and the ring on the pill’s left button while this profile is active. That way you can see which profile applies while dictating, without clicking.
Wie stark die KI das Diktat glättet. „Wi: How strongly the AI smooths the dictation. “Same as Settings” = the global value from Settings → AI & Text.
In welcher Sprache in diesen Apps diktie: Which language you dictate in in these apps. “Same as Settings” = the global value from Settings → General. “Detect automatically” costs accuracy on short dictations.
Ob in diesen Apps ein gesprochenes Safe-: Whether a spoken safe word triggers commands in these apps. The » button on the pill always works.
Nach dem Einfügen zusätzlich Enter drück: Also press Enter after inserting — handy in AI chats, dangerous in emails.
Gilt nur für die diesem Profil zugewiese: Only applies to the apps assigned to this profile and only to a normal dictation — after a command or a fallback to raw text, nothing is ever sent automatically. With the “Email” output format the checkbox deliberately has no effect: an email that sends itself is the one case where a slip has real consequences.
Zeigt Eingriffsgrad, Safe-Word und autom: Shows editing level, safe word and automatic sending. Without it, a profile consists of name, output format and quick switch — enough for most people. Which app gets which profile is set on the “Apps” page.
Kein Prompt (Formeln laufen ohne Modell): No prompt (formulas run without a model)
